$comment: Spec 011 NFR-008 budgets (minified + gzipped bytes, the larger of bun and esbuild) and the runtime modules the side-effect-only suite checks (FR-043). A new runtime module must be listed here.

budgets.name: one exception class (throw new InvalidOperationException(), literal getter)
budgets.$comment: The reflection functions stay out of an exception bundle. Minified bundles rename them, so each is marked by text only its body keeps: getRuntimeType by its Temporal toStringTag cases, implementsInterface by its plainImplementers read, isType by its descriptor .test( call.

budgets.name: isType + getRuntimeType + one class descriptor
budgets.$comment: Raised by the maintainer (stage 011b B3): bun 1758 B / esbuild 1727 B with the box unwrap in isType and getRuntimeType (was bun 1646 B / esbuild 1620 B). Raised from 1.2 KB to 1.7 KB by the maintainer (stage 011b B1): measured bun 1646 B / esbuild 1620 B = entry class + literal getter + isType ~241 B, the NullReferenceException chain getRuntimeType(null) throws ~599 B, getRuntimeType with every descriptor it can answer + getNumberType ~800 B.

budgets.name: one primitive descriptor (Int32Type with isInt32)
budgets.$comment: 0.2 KB rounded up to whole bytes (maintainer, stage 011b B1): measured esbuild 205 B / bun 203 B, the contract literal with isInt32 and nothing else.

budgets.name: box + Boxed (a boxed enum)
budgets.$comment: Raised by the maintainer (stage 011b B3 fix round 1) to 490 B: measured bun 485 B / esbuild 486 B. The Boxed class with its $boxed brand, valueOf / toJSON, the .NET enum text whose flags decomposition runs on BigInt bit tests in value order (exact at every width, one code path; +55 B over the 32-bit form) and the entry's descriptor literal.
